examples.text: Он смотрит, как будто знает всё.
examples.trans: He looks as if he knows everything.

examples.trans: You look at me as if you want to kill me.

Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: иметь в виду = to mean, to have in mind

examples.text: Из окна красивый вид на парк.
examples.trans: There is a nice view of the park from the window.

examples.text: Что вы имеете в виду, Клавдия Викторовна?
examples.trans: What do you mean, Klavdia Viktorovna?

examples.trans: Have new problems arisen in the restaurant again?
I have no idea at all.

examples.text: Я человек чистый. Я вообще не вор.
examples.trans: I'm an honest man. I'm not a thief at all.

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

examples.trans: We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

examples.trans: The guest gladly asked for seconds.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Здравствуйте, мы тут в лифте застряли.
examples.trans: Hello, we're stuck in the elevator here.

examples.trans: It just won't come off, it's completely stuck!
I might get stuck on the turn.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.trans: And I'll ruin my relationship with the future mayor.

examples.trans: Excuse us, we have a bit of a mess here.

examples.trans: Say a firework hit the power station. Three districts without electricity.

examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
